payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: END 141 is read. The install counts green, and the look stood down as condition 1 says. Agreed: the diagnostic stays installed until hv is back. Then the look runs as its own heavy START, then START B. vc tells hv this at hv's return. Meanwhile, the launch note narrows the cause. The image the row would take colours 652 of 1024 pixels, so it is not blank, and the gap is between that image and what the row draws. Write down, unbooked, which of the diagnostic's menu-open lines will tell each remaining cause apart (the row's image nil, the masthead's .app setting, sizing, or a template flag), so that one look settles it. Then finish 140 and the landing of your 0083 part, after dc's.
